pages.title: Linbing freezing device
pages.text: To produce traditional fuel, you need to find springs of crude oil in the vast sea and then perform complicated processing...The Linbing freezing device allows you to create a more efficient fuel-Linbing fuel. Compared with three barrels of traditional refined fuel to launch a rocket, Linbing fuel only requires one barrel.

The first step in producing ice fuel is to go beneath the surface of those cold planets and look for ice fragment ore. Throwing a piece of ice fragment into the ice freezing device can convert 25 mB of ice fuel; ice, ice floe and blue ice can also be used as backup materials to produce fuel. Put the empty barrel on the right side to get out the ice fuel.

pages.title: Ice fuel
pages.text: The extraordinary performance of Linbing Fuel also implies its dangers. Like magma, it will cause damage to entities caught in it; its temperature is very low, but it can be stored in the lower realm without worrying about being evaporated; it is also an eternal freezing source that can continuously freeze the water on the side into ice cubes.
